title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: Compatibility: updated the World of Tanks 2.4.1.1 micro-update contracts to EU source 2.4.1.5514, including the hangar carousel patch, native vehicle-marker movie and Flash libraries.
Minimap: custom enhancements now run only in Random Battles and 7x7/Onslaught (Comp7). Other modes and events retain the native minimap; saved settings are preserved.
Assets: optimized Account Manager icons and player-panel HP textures, reducing source PNG size by approximately 4.62 MiB.
Validation: the project owner confirmed the locally installed EU test build after in-game testing. EU/NA build resource checks passed; this does not establish new NA or ASIA in-game validation.
Beta release for World of Tanks 2.4.1.1 on Wargaming EU, NA and ASIA; Common Test is not the production build target.
